title: Recover safely when a result is uncertain
summary: When a result is missing or uncertain, first check the current feature state and keep the same request identity before trying the same action again.

body.text: A lost response does not prove that a save or submission failed. Reload the current feature state before repeating an action that can change saved work.

items: Keep the original request identity when the feature offers an unchanged retry.
Do not create a changed request until the current result is known.
If the feature remains unavailable, keep learner-owned work and return to the owning task.

applicability.label: Features that report unavailable, degraded, or uncertain results
